message: prototype: all domains integrated (contracts catalog, mock handlers, fixtures)

report.integrate:
Stage A integration finished, and every required check passes. The catalog now lists all 25 endpoint maps (918 endpoints), and a new test fails if a contract module's map is left out. The registry loads every handler module with no skips and serves every catalog endpoint. The new src/mock-api/fixtures/consistency.test.ts (23 tests) walks all fixture exports and checks, across domains:
- tender, contract, request and qualification-application references and their ids;
- persona emails and tenant slugs;
- every in-app link against the routes the SPA features register, and that the record it names exists;
- approval ids that other domains carry;
- deadlines in the tender timetable, clarifications addenda, publication notices, bids, calendars and org-admin;
- lot ids in bids against the tenders domain;
- opening and evaluation receipts against the bids receipts;
- AC-19 exact (Tsodilo 88.00 first, Serowe 86.00; evaluated costs 120,000 / 100,000), via the running handlers;
- award values between approvals, awards and contracts (AC-28); Chobe insurance expiring 8 Oct (AC-09); authority limits and delegation 7 (AC-05).

Fixture reconciliation done to make those checks pass:
- T-2026-0002 deadline is 21 Oct 10:00Z after Addendum 1 (was 14 Oct), and T-2026-0011 is 23 Oct. The workspace T-0002 story was rewritten to Addendum 1 (OIML R49), with receipt RCPT-2026-000021 as the effective one, and Chobe's late attempt moved to T-2026-0008.
- T-2026-0013 and T-2026-0014 added to the tender register; T-0011 now has lots 1101/1102.
- Opening modes aligned (T1 and T8 staged, T9 single). T-0008 opening moved to 2 Oct, off the public holidays.
- Tender versions follow the issued addenda. The tenders domain now takes its policy versions, request list and strategy list from the policy and requests fixtures, and the ODC calendar id is 5.
- C-2025-0007 is contract id 4 in every domain. Makgadikgadi's application is QA-2026-0006 (id 503) in tasks, notifications and org-admin.
- T-2026-0009 stage-two bidders are Serowe and Limpopo in bids, publication and reporting.
- Approvals 35, 36, 38 and 42 match the award and contract figures. New approvals were seeded: disposals 58, 59 and 61; a pending T-0009 award approval 39 for Keabetswe; and contract approvals 14301–14310, now derived from the contracts fixtures and linked in the workspace.
- The reporting dashboard now reads its approvals from the approvals fixtures; reporting search links now point at documents and tasks that exist.
- Workspace evidence references now use the suppliers evidence library ids.
- Org-admin authority and delegation facts match the approval workspace.
- T-0007 standstill ends 8 Oct and its evaluation plan matches the awards debrief criteria.
- Personas: Makgadikgadi and Limpopo admins can sign and submit, Tsodilo's signatory holds the finance role, and dineo.legal has the invited ODC membership 514. Support grant 1 now expires 12 Oct.

Custom business fields (ADM-07) are wired into the request form, the tender edit dialog, the supplier qualification application (only supplier-visible fields) and the contract create and edit forms, with read-only display on the request, tender and assessment pages. Contracts gained an optional `customFields` in the create/update bodies and details. The mock validates the values on every save. Required fields are checked when the record leaves draft: request submission, tender release-approval request, application submission and contract submit for review. src/mock-api/custom-fields.ts holds the shared logic, and the recorded demo values live in the policy fixtures.

Shared components:
- describeError now shows the problem detail for a business-coded 403.
- ConfirmActionDialog takes a size; Checkbox takes hideLabel; a DataTable column width is kept as its minimum width.
- New CSS classes .tiq-stack--start and .tiq-list-plain.
- The download button's accessible name now includes its label.
- ApprovalStatusPanel shows the routing to a higher authority and the change that invalidated an approval.
- Recharts' keyboard layer is disabled inside the hidden chart wrapper. This fixed an axe `aria-hidden-focus` failure in the e2e run.

Twenty status-like enumerations moved into enums.ts (registered with labels and chip tones), and the domain modules re-export them. Submission attempt outcomes got readable labels.

The sidebar now has one position and one icon per destination for every organization kind, and the operator lands on /ops/customers. A new navCoherence test holds this.

The OpenAPI generator used to emit `$defs` references that did not resolve inside the document; it now moves them to components.schemas. A new test validates the document and compares it with the committed openapi.json.

Test-count floors: `ci:test:ui` minimum is 1360 (1370 run), and a new `ci:test:unit` script has minimum 2690 (2703 run).

Runtime smoke on port 4190:
- health returned 200 `{"status":"ok","version":"v1"}` with an x-correlation-id;
- tebogo.officer signed in, and /me/context returned 200 with memberships and mode "prototype";
- a forged token and an expired token each got 401;
- a foreign X-Tenant-Id got the uniform 403 problem+json (TENANT_ACCESS_DENIED).
The server was stopped afterwards.

Not done because they need changes outside my ownership or the owner's decision: permission codes (they would change the blueprint), deriving the ids of other domains' bids, reconciling category ids, and one shared demo "as of" date. These are listed below.
